transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, it’s a little embarrassing to say, but I guess it’s my eating. I’m not sure if it’s a big deal or if I’m making too much of it, but after my evening class sometimes I’ll stop and get food, like a full fast-food meal, and then I’ll also get candy from the vending machine… and when I get home I might keep snacking. It feels like I’m sort of making up for not eating much earlier in the day.
When you find yourself snacking a lot or eating a full meal after class, do you feel like you can't control what you're eating or how much you're eating at those times?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but sometimes it does feel that way. Once I start with the snacks, I’ll tell myself, “Okay, just close the bag and go to bed,” but then I keep reaching in anyway. And afterward I feel pretty embarrassed, kind of sick of myself.
After these episodes of eating more than you intended, do you ever try to compensate by doing something like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?

I… yeah, a few times. Not all the time, and I know it’s not a good thing to do. But after some of those late-night eating spells, I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up because I got scared that all the food would show on me. It’s embarrassing to admit.
Do these episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control happen specifically when you're alone, and do they cause you a lot of distress afterward?

Yeah… mostly it’s when I’m by myself. I don’t think I’d do that in front of anyone. And afterward, yes, I feel pretty bad about it. I keep telling myself, “Just close the bag and go to bed,” but my hands keep going back for more, and then I’m embarrassed and kind of sick of myself. I don’t know if that makes sense.
How often do these episodes of feeling out of control while eating and eating a lot happen, on average?

I guess… on average, it’s been about once a week. Usually one night after class, for maybe the last three months or so, where I eat too much and feel like I can’t stop, and then… I make myself throw up afterward. It’s not every day or anything, but yeah, probably at least weekly.

Can you describe what happens during one of these episodes where you feel out of control with eating? Specifically, would you say you’re eating much more rapidly than normal, eating until you’re uncomfortably full, or eating large amounts of food when you’re not physically hungry?

I mean… I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but yeah, it can be a lot more than I’d normally eat. After my evening class, sometimes I stop and get a full fast-food meal, and then I’ll grab candy from the vending machine too. And then when I get home, I’ll still have more snacks, like I’m trying to make up for not eating much or just getting through the whole day.

It feels kind of embarrassing saying it out loud, but in the moment it’s like I just keep going. Does that answer what you mean?
During these episodes when you're eating a lot, do you feel like you've lost control — like you can't stop eating or can't control what you eat once you start?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t like saying it that way, because it sounds like I’m making excuses, but once I start on the snacks, I’ll tell myself, “Okay, close the bag and go to bed,” and then I just… keep reaching back in. It’s like I can’t quite make myself stop until I’m embarrassed and feel sick of myself. Does that count as losing control?
Do these episodes and the way you feel about them interfere with your daily life, like your schoolwork, social life, or how you feel about yourself?

A little, yeah… I mean, I’m still getting my bookkeeping work done, and I keep up with my coursework okay, so it’s not like everything’s falling apart.

But I have noticed I kind of leave class fast now. I don’t hang around and talk with people the way I used to. I just feel embarrassed and… preoccupied, I guess, like I want to get home. It probably affects how I feel about myself more than I’d like to admit. Does that make sense?
Do you regularly use behaviors like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or doing excessive exercise to try to control your weight or shape after these eating episodes?

Um… not really with laxatives or anything like that. And I wouldn’t say exercise, no.

I’m embarrassed to admit this, but… a few times after those late-night eating spells, I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up. It wasn’t like every time, but I got scared that all the food would show on me, if that makes sense. I know that probably sounds bad.
When you made yourself vomit after those late-night eating spells, was it usually after eating a much larger amount of food than most people would eat in a similar period of time?

Yeah… I guess it was after a lot. I mean, I don’t know what most people would call “a lot,” but after class I’ll sometimes stop and get a whole fast-food meal, then maybe candy from the vending machine, and when I get home I’ll still eat more snacks.

It feels like I’m making up for the whole day or something. I know that probably sounds excessive… but yes, that’s usually when I’ve felt panicked enough to make myself throw up.
